text:
No single product in these results wirelessly charges a laptop, phone and watch together. The practical answer is one of two setups.

## Option 1: One box for laptop and phone (Baseus Nomos 5-in-1, $149.99)
- It has a 140 W USB-C port (PD 3.1), enough for a 16-inch MacBook Pro. It also has a built-in retractable 100 W cable, a second USB-C port, a USB-A port and a 15 W Qi2 phone pad.
- It runs everything from one outlet and can power 1-5 devices at once.
- **Watch:** its listed ports don't include a watch charger. You'd plug your watch's own charger into a USB port.
- **Caveats:** it was sold out on Baseus's US store when checked on 2026-10-21, so check stock. Only one port reaches 140 W. Baseus doesn't publish how power splits when several devices are plugged in. Returns are 7 days, no reason needed.
- [Buy at Baseus (affiliate link)](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-nomos-5-in-1-140w-qi2). Details: https://dealectric.com/baseus-nomos-5-in-1-140w-qi2

## Option 2: A wireless 3-in-1 stand plus a laptop charger
This is better if you have an iPhone, Apple Watch and AirPods and want them all wireless.
- **Anker MagGo 3-in-1 Charging Station:** StandDeskLab's top pick. It lists at $89.99 and is often around $67-70. It has a Qi2 15 W phone pad plus watch and earbud spots, and folds flat. See https://standdesklab.com/accessories/best-desk-charging-station/
- **Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand:** WIRED's best overall at $109 (about $80-98 elsewhere). It's a chrome stand with a tilting phone pad, and it fast-charges Apple Watch Series 7 or newer. See https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/
- **Laptop side:** the Anker 341 USB-C Hub (about $40) passes through up to 100 W to a laptop, per StandDeskLab. If you need more ports or monitors, WIRED's laptop dock guide has options: https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-laptop-docking-stations/

## My pick
- **Baseus Nomos** if you want one tidy unit and a high-wattage laptop port, and you can live with a wired watch charger.
- **Anker MagGo or Belkin stand plus a laptop charger or hub** if you want phone, watch and earbuds on a pad.

The Office Journal lists a Baseus Nomos 245 W model, which appears to be a different version from the 140 W one above. I didn't find a price or stock for it. Tell me your laptop model and phone/watch brand and I can check the wattage and compatibility.
